project.name: nablatensor-engine-opencl
project.description: Everything OpenCL: the java.lang.foreign runtime (ICD loader dlopen, clBuildProgram, 1-D clEnqueueNDRangeKernel, no JNI, no native jar) and the replay engine — the recorded tape becomes a fused forward+adjoint OpenCL C kernel (the CUDA code generator, lightly rewritten to OpenCL C), so any conformant OpenCL 1.2+ device with cl_khr_fp64 can run it. Gates at runtime.
